title: Limit Number of Vehicles for Private Hire Arrangements
what_it_is: Limit Number of Vehicles for Private Hire Arrangements

sections.label: Market to determine industry growth
sections.summary: The stated preference is to leave the industry's growth to the market to determine.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Our preference for now is to leave it to the market to determine the growth of the industry.

sections.label: Grab and Uber competition effects
sections.summary: A survey showed Grab and Uber took half the market share within three years, the point-to-point market doubled, and their ratings beat taxis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Within three years of their introduction, our recent survey showed that Grab and Uber have grabbed half of the market share.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: In other words, the taxi operators' market share today is only about half.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: What it means is that the whole point-to-point market has actually doubled in size after the introduction of Grab and Uber.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: When consumers and commuters were asked for their opinion about new services like Grab or Uber, they rated them high and higher than taxis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: What is also very comforting is that their rating on taxis has also improved and, when asked, they said it is because of competition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: So, in this particular space, competition has been good, and  our approach in not stifling these new services that are being brought in because of innovative business models, is something that has been good for Singaporeans and commuters, and I would like to maintain that approach.

sections.label: COE bids by private hire players
sections.summary: Evidence does not suggest Grab and Uber pushed up COEs, as top private hire players bid roughly at market rate each cycle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As for COEs, there has been some speculation that the COE is being pushed up because of Grab and Uber.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: And the evidence does not suggest that, because when we look at the top players in this field of private hire services, the bids that they put into the COE in each cycle were more or less at the market rate.
